name: ExampleAddon
description: Minimal addon — only required fields (name + git + branch). `name` must be a safe_folder (no separators, no traversal).

name: ExampleAddonPinned
description: Pinned to a tag via `ref`; when `ref` is set it wins over `branch`. Both must be whitespace-free and without `..`.

name: ExampleAddonCodeberg
description: Codeberg/Gitea-hosted addon — any allowlisted git host (github, gitlab, gitea, codeberg plus `addon_git_hosts`).

name: ExampleBlockedAddon
description: Blocked addon — launcher will not install it when `blocked: true`.

name: ExampleRecommendedAddon
description: Recommended addon — shown as recommended in the UI when `recommended: true`.

name: ExampleNoBranch
description: No branch/ref — defaults to the repo default branch (HEAD).
Legacy `folder` alias for `name` — both accepted, `name` takes precedence when both present.
